# vector spec frozen

Refuse a change that edits a frozen contract.

## Usage

```text
vector spec frozen [contracts...] [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="[contracts...]">

the contracts to check, from the repository's top (default: every contracts/*.json)

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="--base" type="&lt;ref&gt;">

the commit the change is against

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--repo" type="&lt;dir&gt;">

the repository (default: the current directory)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--format" type="&lt;f&gt;">

text (default), markdown (a PR comment) or json

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>
